text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*...!
Not yet! If it's just this much...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On a day off, while heading to the mountains for some exercise,
I spotted Daring Heart in front of the station.
choice_data_list: Running even though it's your day off?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
High ambitions alone won't make you strong.
You've gotta put in the real work!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Contradicting her cheerful reply, she was running hard even on her day off.
I saw her off, moved by her stoic dedication.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
What a coincidence!
I had no idea we were heading to the same place!
What a surprise!
choice_data_list: Did you really run all the way here!?
Did you really run all the way here!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Isn't it obvious?
After all, this is training!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Alright, warm-up's done!
Now the real show begins!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Paved roads simply aren't enough to build up my body……
You really can't beat the mountains!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Because we can only do uphill training on a mountain!
I put extra effort into running on rough footing.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Charging up those hills gives my legs such a good burn...!
It's seriously exciting!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Whenever there's a big rock,
I just jump right over it, you know?♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she was already covered in mud,
her eyes sparkled brightly as she fixed her gaze on lofty goals.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It's not just my heart that needs to be strong—my running has to be, too!
Make sure to cheer for me during my race, okay?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh, do you like mountains too?
That makes us kindred spirits!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hey, why don't you run too?
The mountain air is so refreshing!
